# What time do you have to start baking?

> Free bakery production scheduler. Paste your products and orders with due times; get a backwards-planned prep, proof and bake timeline, the ovens and bakers you need, and which orders to drop when it does not fit. Nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
